text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
No, no! Snacking on the go is just
going to make this furisode heavier...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Hm? Nature-chan, is something the matter?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
âAh, Ryan-senpai.
Umm... I'd like a quick consultation about my upper arm fat.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! That's great, fat is a treasure!
After all, it turns into energy for muscle!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! Running into each other here must be fate!
Why don't we try it out with some muscle training right now?

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ohh! Are you sure?
Your workout routines look like they'd be crazy effective, Senpai!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
Ah... but, um...
Please go easy on me...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Let's start with that pull-up bar over there,
how about 50 pull-ups to kick things off!

text_block_list.name: Nice Nature
text_block_list.text:
S-Senp... aii! My arms, my arms!
They're... screaming in pain, though!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Your muscles are rejoicing! Only 5 reps left!
Savor that joy till the very end... MUSCLE♪

...Thanks in part to Mejiro Ryan's muscle training,
Nice Nature successfully lost weight!
